text: Thank you for your email and warm support for our upcoming campus event.
I am writing to share details about the craftsmen's show and how you can assist with our preparation work.
First, regarding the demonstration, the young craftsmen will bring traditional works like paper cutting and clay art, showing how they combine old skills with modern designs.
Students will certainly find it worthwhile to watch closely and make a small gift themselves.
Second, as for the preparation work, it would be deeply appreciated if you could help arrange tables in the hall on Friday afternoon and guide other international students during the event.
Thank you again for your kindness.
Looking forward to working with you soon!
